title: Dhwani TTS: Developer Notice & Feedback
short_msg: Hello! This app is under active development. Double tap to read our message and share your valuable feedback.
full_msg:
Warm greetings to all our users from Interested Technology for Blind!

Please note that Dhwani TTS is currently under active development. Because we are continuously working on new features and improvements, you might occasionally experience minor bugs or issues with certain voices.

If you face any problems or notice any voice issues, please report them and share your suggestions with the developer. Your feedback is extremely important to us and helps us make Dhwani TTS better, faster, and more accessible for everyone.

Thank you for your continuous support!
update_notes: Version 1.7.0 is live with Indian voices, anti-stutter phoneme support, and HD audio boost.
